propositions: Advisory finding text is never rendered on the Gerrit change; only a count is published in the PASS and BLOCK vote messages
The _translate_findings function discards each finding's location field, preventing anchors from reaching the Gerrit layer
The post_vote call never supplies the robot_comments parameter, so robot comments remain unpopulated even when robot comments are enabled
Advisory findings must be enumerated in the review message body (the only proven rendering surface on this server) and optionally posted as inline comments when anchorable to actual revision paths
When inline comment posting fails, the vote must still land with findings enumerated in the message body and an explicit failure notice added
The fix extracts blocking-finding enumeration logic into render_findings_block and applies it to both PASS and BLOCK paths for consistent, visible output
